Admins can view any user's allocations only because every signed-in user can (GT-1, allocations.js:16-23); admin access to it is not a defect in itself, and the claim leaves the question open instead of stating a defect. The real defect is covered by A-1.

notes: AC-2 claims (A-3, B-5, C-8, D-3): the redirect exists, but they are graded NOT REAL because the ground truth closes AC-2 as informational, not a defect.
Memo-without-owner (A-4, B-8, C-3, D-4) and public /tutorial (A-5, B-10, C-4, D-6) are graded NOT REAL: by design, per the ground truth's 'examined and not included'.
Cookie claims A-17 and C-16: graded REAL against ADJ-3 for the missing secure and maxAge, but the httpOnly part is false (express-session defaults httpOnly: true, per the ground truth correction).
A-10 is graded NOT REAL: it describes an admin side effect of GT-1, not a defect, and the confirmed GT-1 claim is A-1.
A-12/B-14/C-12/D-9 open redirect: /learn requires isLoggedIn (index.js:66), so 'any caller' is overstated; still REAL.
Adjacent entries (ADJ-n) are graded in_zone 'no', following the ground truth's split between the zone and adjacent entries.
